title: Microsoft Sizzle: Business Central Agents In Action

chapters.title: Business Central Overview and AI Evolution
Introduction to Sales Order and Payables Agents

features.name: Sales Order Agent
features.description: Automates order processing by eliminating manual entry, checking inventory, generating quotes, and ensuring fast and accurate customer fulfillment.

features.name: Payables Agent
features.description: Reads vendor invoices, classifies invoice lines, assigns them to appropriate accounts, and routes them for approval to streamline finance team workflows.

features.name: Custom Agents Framework
features.description: Users can build their own agents to automate unique workflows, connect to other Microsoft tools, and customize agents to fit their business with security, transparency, and configurability.

quotes.text: the next evolution of business agility is here. Workflow automation with Sales Order Agent and Payables Agent
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the status and positioning of the two main agents as available features for workflow automation

quotes.text: Sales Order Agent takes the hassle out of order processing. No more manual entry or chasing down details

quotes.text: It reads vendor invoices, classifies invoice lines, assigns to the appropriate accounts, and routes them for approval
quotes.why_it_matters: Details the specific workflow steps the Payables Agent performs in invoice processing

quotes.text: you can start building your own agents today
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms that custom agent building capability is available now, not future functionality

quotes.text: Automate your unique workflows. Connect to other Microsoft tools and customize agents to fit your business perfectly
